messages:
tess_cs: Drafting outbound for impacted onboarding customers. Need quick sanity check: short summary, RCA, mitigation, ETA, credit offer, office hours RSVP, and renewal escalation path. Will send once we have sign-off.

anu_eng: RCA: a deployment unintentionally changed queue-shard weights at ~02:45 UTC which caused sustained rate limiting on a subset of ingestion workers. Rolled back at 03:12 UTC and kicked off a backfill. Throughput is ~85% now; estimated full catch-up 4-7 hours depending on burst traffic. Incident INC-2026-58024.

mike_ae: Please include explicit language for customers in renewal windows: offer a 30-minute consult + a one-time onboarding credit. AE to be cc'ed for any customers flagged as renewal-risk.

yara_se: I can run office hours and capture technical blockers. Suggest two slots: 15:30 UTC & 19:00 UTC. Attach a 1-page troubleshooting checklist and a short RSVP.

tess_cs: Outbound draft (please edit):

"Hi <Customer>,
We9re sorry for the disruption. Earlier today (~02:45 UTC) a configuration change affected our onboarding ingestion pipeline and delayed processing of some uploads and trial imports. We rolled back the change and started a backfill; processing is progressing and we expect full catch-up within 407 hours.

What happened: queue-shard weight misconfiguration caused throttling for part of the worker pool (INC-2026-58024).
What we did: rolled back the change, scaled up backfill capacity by 3x, patched the shard weights, and added extra monitoring.
Impact: no data loss. Search/embedding completeness will be restored when backfill completes.
Next steps: we9ll host two office hours today (15:30 UTC & 19:00 UTC) — RSVP here: <RSVP_LINK>. We9re also offering a one-time onboarding credit up to $150 for affected onboarding windows (credits applied at company discretion; see T&Cs: <T_AND_C_LINK>). If you9re in a renewal window or need prioritized assistance, reply to this message and we9ll schedule a 30-minute review with Solutions Engineering and your AE.
Apologies again and thank you for your patience.

99Tess, Customer Success"

anu_eng: small edits applied: replace "scaled up backfill capacity by 3x" -> "temporarily increased backfill workers by 3x" and add public incident link: https://redwood.status/incidents/INC-2026-58024

legal_bot: legal approves "one-time onboarding credit up to $150" phrasing. Must include "credits applied at company discretion" and link to T&Cs.

mike_ae: I9ll flag renewal accounts and set SEP handoffs for any accounts with upcoming renewals. I can join reviews for escalations.

yara_se: I9ll host the two office hours and attach the troubleshooting checklist + calendar invites. I9ll capture feedback and summarize common issues for eng.

inc_bot: INC-2026-58024 status: RESOLVED (rollback + backfill in progress). Public status: https://redwood.status/incidents/INC-2026-58024 :white_check_mark:

tess_cs: Final pre-send checklist: 1) include T&C link 2) attach RSVP + calendar invites 3) append renewal-flagged list and AE contacts 4) include 1-question feedback checkbox about renewal impact. Target send 10:00 UTC. Posting final copy here before sending. :thumbsup:
